verses.text: For the chief musician, on stringed instruments. A psalm by David. Answer when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me room to breathe in my distress. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
How long will you people turn my honor into shame? Will you keep loving what’s empty and chasing lies? Selah.
Know this: the LORD has set apart those who are faithful to him. The LORD will hear when I call to him.
Stand in awe and don’t sin. When you’re lying in bed, look into your own heart and be still. Selah.
Offer sacrifices that are right and put your trust in the LORD.
Many people ask, “Who’s going to show us anything good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.
You’ve put more joy in my heart than they have when their grain and new wine overflow.
I’ll lie down and go to sleep in peace. You alone, LORD, let me live in safety.
